description: This file is a C source file implementing various utility functions and data structures for the LibXDiff library, including functions for file handling, diff computation, hashing, and line matching.

methods.name: long xdl_bogosqrt(long n)
methods.description: Calculates an integer approximation of the square root using shifts.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diffrec(char const * rec,long size,char const * pre,long psize,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Outputs a diff record in a specific format using callback functions.

methods.name: void * xdl_mmfile_first(mmfile_t * mmf,long * size)
methods.description: Returns the first pointer and size of the memory-mapped file.

methods.name: long xdl_mmfile_size(mmfile_t * mmf)
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory-mapped file.

methods.name: void xdl_cha_free(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Frees all nodes in a character storage chain.

methods.name: void * xdl_cha_alloc(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Allocates a new node in the character storage chain.

methods.name: long xdl_guess_lines(mmfile_t * mf,long sample)
methods.description: Estimates the number of lines in a memory-mapped file based on a sample.

methods.name: int xdl_blankline(const char * line,long size,long flags)
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank, considering whitespace flags.

methods.name: int xdl_recmatch(const char * l1,long s1,const char * l2,long s2,long flags)
methods.description: Compares two lines with various whitespace ignoring flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)
methods.description: Computes a hash of a line considering whitespace flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_verbatim(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top)
methods.description: Computes a hash of a line verbatim, character by character.

methods.name: unsigned int xdl_hashbits(unsigned int size)
methods.description: Calculates the number of hash bits needed for a given size.

methods.name: int xdl_num_out(char * out,long val)
methods.description: Converts a long value to a string representation.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emits a diff hunk header, either formatted or via callback.

methods.name: int xdl_fall_back_diff(xdfenv_t * diff_env,xpparam_t const * xpp,int line1,int count1,int line2,int count2)
methods.description: Performs a fallback diff operation on file subranges.

methods.name: void * xdl_alloc_grow_helper(void * p,long nr,long * alloc,size_t size)
methods.description: Helper to grow a memory buffer with reallocation.
